summary: First Community Corp announced a share repurchase plan authorized by its Board, allocating up to $7.5 million (approx. 3.4% of total shareholders' equity as of Mar 31, 2026) to buy back common stock through May 5, 2027. Repurchases may occur via open market or privately negotiated transactions at management's discretion, subject to market conditions, share issuance, and regulatory requirements. The plan is not a binding obligation and can be suspended or cancelled at any time. No specific price, premium, or tender offer mechanics are outlined. Focus on execution pace, actual buyback volumes, and potential EPS accretion.
